limitations: Shared desktop host; aggregate counters include test setup/auth/migrations and background work. No specific background application cost or API-only CPU/I/O attribution measured.

Resource windows approximate each complete run cycle at ~4s resolution, not the bid-only interval. Adjacent windows share boundary snapshots; run3 sampled memory window ends ~1.2s before its report. Do not infer phase-specific causality or subsecond spikes.
iostat CPU values use its final 1s interval, not its cumulative first row. memory_pressure -Q free percentage is reported directly, not a pressure severity classification.

Nonzero swap is not an invalidation criterion. No observed infrastructure failure or stability threat; measured thresholds pass under these recorded conditions. Dedicated-host repeatability and production latency are unproven.
Light monitoring itself adds some overhead; no diagnostic or second acceptance series was run.

security: Temporary NOSUPERUSER/NOCREATEDB/NOCREATEROLE role granted CONNECT/CREATE only for own schemas on existing disposable DB, plus CONNECT postgres catalog check. Generated password stayed in memory; SQL via stdin; no env/credential files read. Role dropped; no schemas remained for fallback cleanup. No host5432 or other database used.
